Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body: A vampire with Perfectionist successfully hunts and a reacting vampire plays Follow the blood. Does the acting vampire gain the blood from Perfectionist?

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Perfectionist
Type: Master
Master: archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once per turn, when this vampire sucessfully performs an action and no reaction cards are played, he or she gains 1 blood after the action is resolved. A vampire can have only one archetype.

Since "Follow the Blood" is a reaction card, "Perfectionist" does not trigger.

Messages.Author: Shockwave
Messages.Body:
I'd think the Vampire does not receive the blood, for precisely the bolded sections provided by M@rc00_L. Perfectionist effectively checks it's text at the end of the action, after there is no window to play further cards. In effect, gaining the Perfectionist blood confirms the action is over.

Incidentally, I'd say it's fairly poor wording on Follow the Blood just because you shouldn't be playing Reactions to Actions after they're resolved, that's surely the point, but I'd guess the intent of that is to make it clear the combat is NOT part of the Action, but is entirely seperate.

Here we go again....

i read the requirements as such:

If action is successful and no reaction is played (during that action), then you can get +1 blood after that action is resolved.

and since follow the blood has to be played after the resolution, the perfectionist's requirements have already been met so the blood is gained before they enter combat.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
I think it is the same as for Freak Drive / Concoction of Vitality: Freak Drive is still part of the action, so you can't play it under Concoction. Here, follow by the blood is still part of the action, so you don't gain the blood.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
I think Perfectionist triggers immediately after resolution, which is before any reacting player would get the impulse to play Follow the Blood. Thus, gain 1+1 blood, and then Follow the Blood gets played.

EDIT: And that's also LSJ's position: boardgamegeek.com/article/6401929#6401929

@ Shockwave: Perfectionist triggers after resolution, but before the end of the action. For instance, the vampire could play Freak Drive after gaining that blood (or before, same window). It's also in that window that the reacting vampire (in a different scenario) could play Touch of Pain.

@ Boris: The difference here is that Perfectionist doesn't trigger as the action ends, but right after it is successful. Freak Drive can be played after gaining Perfectionist's blood Concotion of Vitality extends to the end of the action, which is after Freak Drive's window.

You can't do that for a certain reason: you're still in the action.

I think it's easier to consider it this way:

If there's no blocking minion, and action is successful, there is a window ("after resolution") that is still in the action (as much as "before range is set" or "end of the round" windows are part of the round).
The action will end when (and only when) all players have passed using effects in that window.
This window is when Perfectionist (which is a mandatory effect) triggers. This is also when Follow the Blood, Freak Drive, and other stuff happen. Still part of the action, since before the end of the action.
Similrly, can't transfer 1 blood with Heidelberg Castle, and then play Freak Drive.
